liveness-path.description: Path for the liveness and startup probes, '/' when left out. Only used with an http(s) scheme. Absolute, and limited to safe URL characters: it is interpolated into the generated pod spec.
liveness-path.title: Liveness-Path

port.description: Port to probe; the component's first inbound port when left out. Must be 1024 or higher: images run non-root and cannot bind below that.
port.title: Port

readiness-path.description: Path for the readiness probe, '/' when left out. Only used with an http(s) scheme.
readiness-path.title: Readiness-Path

scheme.description: How the component is probed: 'tcp' opens a connection, 'http'/'https' request a path, 'none' disables probing. Left out means tcp, or none when the component has no inbound port.
scheme.title: Scheme
